description: This file defines the functionality to delete a comment from an article in the Conduit application. It includes a command record, a validator for the command, and a request handler that interacts with the database context to remove a comment based on article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Namespace container class for comment deletion feature bits.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a comment identified by article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command ensuring the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by interacting with the database to remove the specified comment.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Sets validation rule for the Slug property to ensure it is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to find the article by slug, then find and remove the comment by ID from the database.
